brief:
Israel's ministerial security cabinet will convene Thursday against a backdrop of escalating tensions with Iran, according to Hebrew-language Channel 12. The meeting comes as regional friction between the two countries intensifies, though specific details of the agenda were not immediately disclosed.

The gathering represents an apparent response to the heightened security concerns, though the full scope of developments prompting the session remains unclear from initial reports.

title: Israeli security cabinet meets Thursday amid rising Iran tensions
